thread.title: Buffett: I'd Pull the Trigger on a $100B Deal

author: Shoshanna Delventhal
title: Buffett: I'd Pull the Trigger on a $100B Deal
text: Buffett: I'd Pull the Trigger on a $100B Deal Shoshanna Delventhal Reblog While Buffett invested $13 billion to $15 billion in stocks in the first three months of 2018, his firm is still sitting on over $100 billion in cash, which he he called "just about the world's worst investment except doing something dumb that you're doing for a longer term" in an interview with CNBC on Monday. In the first quarter, Berkshire upped its stake in iPhone maker Apple Inc. ( AAPL), garnering a 5% stake in the tech titan. Buffett and Munger have continued to praise Apple after Berkshire's much anticipated annual shareholder meeting held over this weekend, suggesting that they would own 100% of the company if they could.
